# 2 Baruch Chapter 62 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**62:1** "And-those-black-waters which-you-saw next: these-are-all-the-evil-things which-all-the-kings-who-arose-after-that-good-king did, who-forsook-the-LAW-of-the-LORD."

**62:2** "For-they-built-high-places, and-established-idols in-all-the-land, and-led-astray-all-the-people into-all-manner-of-sin; and-they-multiplied-iniquity, and-they-increased-transgression."

**62:3** "And-they-drew-away-from-the-temple-of-the-LORD the-sacrifices, and-they-burned-incense in-other-places, and-they-ceased-to-keep the-holy-months and-the-feasts."

**62:4** "And-they-killed-the-prophets; and-the-voice-of-the-righteous was-no-more-heard; and-they-forsook-the-law of-the-LORD."

**62:5** "And-the-holy-priests were-put-to-flight, and-the-holy-ones-who-were-pure-were-removed from-their-places."

**62:6** "And-all-the-kings who-followed-after-those-kings did-evil, and-they-were-like-them-in-their-deeds."

**62:7** "And-there-was-none-who-kept-the-law in-their-hearts, and-none-who-feared-the-LORD; only-a-few-were-righteous among-them."

**62:8** "These-are-the-fourth-black-waters which-you-saw."

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
